mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets Alloy invent two distinct audit entries that point at the same Operation, which is exactly the 'audit was duplicated / mutated by writing a second row for the same access' scenario the AppendOnly assertion catches.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj a, b: AuditEntry | a.op = b.op }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the fact removes the 'every serviced RecordsLookup has an audit entry' rule; injecting a serviced RecordsLookup with no AuditEntry pointing to it forces the missing-audit counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some op: Operation | op.kind = RecordsLookup and some op.reachedService and (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.op = op) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact lets a record be returned without any active care-team membership; the injection forces such an operation to exist, which is the SC-010 leakage the ownership-based access assertion is meant to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoCareTeamMembership { some op: Operation | some op.recordReturned and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.member = op.caller and m.patient = op.presentedPatient and m.status = MembershipActive) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Denied outcome to still ship record content to the caller; injecting such an Operation produces the byte-non-equivalent leak SC-003 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakOnDeny { some op: Operation | op.result = Denied and some op.recordReturned }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the role/kind authorisation lets a caller whose role is not in the permission matrix still reach the service layer; injecting an AuditOfficer who performs a RecordsLookup at service depth produces the cross-role privilege escalation LeastPrivilege catches.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RoleEscalation { some op: Operation | some op.reachedService and op.caller.role = AuditOfficer and op.kind = RecordsLookup }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact decouples audit-entry attribution from the operation it records; injecting an audit entry whose recorded clinician differs from the operation's actual caller produces a misattribution counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedAudit { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.clinician != ae.op.caller }
